#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a standalone animated SVG of a horse race."""
import random

random.seed(7)

W, H = 1200, 800

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Horse / jockey definitions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
HORSES = [
    dict(n=1, coat="#9A5230", light="#C47B50", dark="#5E2F17",
         mane="#241812", maneLight="#4A3428", hoof="#221A14",
         silk="#D62828", silkDark="#9E1616", accent="#FFC93C",
         cap="#D62828", capAccent="#FFC93C", skin="#D9A06B",
         name="BAY BLAZE", odds="5/2"),
    dict(n=2, coat="#B86434", light="#DC8E58", dark="#7A3817",
         mane="#E7C27A", maneLight="#F6E0B0", hoof="#3A2A1C",
         silk="#1E4ED8", silkDark="#14338F", accent="#F4F7FF",
         cap="#1E4ED8", capAccent="#F4F7FF", skin="#C98A58",
         name="THUNDER", odds="3/1"),
    dict(n=3, coat="#B8BEC6", light="#DEE2E6", dark="#7C848E",
         mane="#4A5058", maneLight="#737C87", hoof="#2A2E34",
         silk="#118A4E", silkDark="#0A5B33", accent="#FFD23F",
         cap="#118A4E", capAccent="#FFD23F", skin="#E0AC7C",
         name="EMERALD FLASH", odds="7/2"),
    dict(n=4, coat="#353036", light="#5B5562", dark="#19161C",
         mane="#0E0C10", maneLight="#2E2834", hoof="#0A090B",
         silk="#6A2FB8", silkDark="#461B80", accent="#FF8A2B",
         cap="#6A2FB8", capAccent="#FF8A2B", skin="#B87A4E",
         name="MIDNIGHT", odds="9/2"),
    dict(n=5, coat="#D9A55C", light="#F1CB86", dark="#A06A2C",
         mane="#F3E4C4", maneLight="#FFF8E7", hoof="#4A3520",
         silk="#E23E8C", silkDark="#A81D5E", accent="#23C7C9",
         cap="#E23E8C", capAccent="#23C7C9", skin="#E8BC8C",
         name="GOLDEN GAMBLE", odds="6/1"),
]

LANES = [
    dict(y=455, scale=0.70, dur=7.6, begin=-1.80),
    dict(y=505, scale=0.75, dur=8.4, begin=-3.60),
    dict(y=555, scale=0.80, dur=7.0, begin=-6.05),
    dict(y=605, scale=0.86, dur=7.9, begin=-4.90),
    dict(y=655, scale=0.92, dur=8.8, begin=-2.70),
]

BODY_PATH = ("M -76,-66 C -84,-90 -70,-112 -42,-116 L 18,-114 "
             "C 46,-116 64,-104 70,-88 C 76,-72 66,-56 46,-48 "
             "C 24,-40 -8,-40 -30,-44 C -56,-48 -72,-54 -76,-66 Z")

NECK_PATH = ("M 40,-106 C 54,-114 70,-130 82,-148 L 106,-138 "
             "C 96,-120 92,-96 92,-72 L 58,-68 C 58,-84 50,-98 40,-106 Z")

HEAD_PATH = ("M 86,-148 C 90,-162 102,-170 116,-166 L 146,-154 "
             "C 158,-150 157,-139 146,-136 L 126,-133 L 117,-121 "
             "L 102,-122 L 94,-132 Z")

MANE_PATH = ("M 88,-152 C 80,-146 74,-138 68,-128 C 62,-118 54,-110 44,-104 "
             "C 54,-108 62,-116 68,-126 C 64,-116 62,-106 58,-98 "
             "C 66,-108 74,-122 80,-134 C 78,-126 78,-118 76,-112 "
             "C 84,-124 90,-138 94,-150 Z")

TAIL_PATH = ("M -70,-92 C -88,-98 -106,-94 -122,-84 C -136,-75 -144,-62 -143,-50 "
             "C -136,-62 -124,-72 -110,-78 C -122,-68 -130,-56 -132,-44 "
             "C -122,-58 -108,-70 -92,-78 C -82,-82 -74,-86 -70,-92 Z")

TORSO_PATH = ("M -12,-112 C -10,-128 -2,-144 10,-152 C 22,-149 26,-136 21,-122 "
              "C 17,-111 6,-103 -4,-101 C -10,-104 -12,-108 -12,-112 Z")


def leg(px, py, upper_len, lower_len, up_w, low_w, up_vals, low_vals,
        color, dark, light, hoof, begin, dur, hind=False):
    """One articulated leg. Pivot at px,py; local origin at pivot."""
    return f'''
      <g transform="translate({px},{py})">
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
            values="{up_vals}" keyTimes="0;0.2;0.45;0.7;1"
            dur="{dur:.2f}s" begin="{begin:.3f}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <path d="M0,0 L0,{upper_len}" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="{up_w}"
            stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
          <path d="M-2.5,1 L-2.5,{upper_len - 3}" stroke="{light}" stroke-width="3"
            stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity=".38"/>
          <g transform="translate(0,{upper_len})">
            <g>
              <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
                values="{low_vals}" keyTimes="0;0.2;0.45;0.7;1"
                dur="{dur:.2f}s" begin="{begin:.3f}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
              <path d="M0,0 L0,{lower_len}" stroke="{dark}" stroke-width="{low_w}"
                stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
              <path d="M-2,1 L-2,{lower_len - 2}" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="2.4"
                stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity=".55"/>
              <path d="M -7,{lower_len - 2} L 6,{lower_len - 2} L 8,{lower_len + 7} L -8,{lower_len + 7} Z"
                fill="{hoof}" stroke="#100d0b" stroke-width="1"/>
              <path d="M -6,{lower_len + 1} L 6,{lower_len + 1}" stroke="#6d5c4a"
                stroke-width="1" opacity=".5"/>
            </g>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>'''


def horse(idx, cfg, lane, number):
    n = cfg["n"]
    dur = lane["dur"]
    begin = lane["begin"]
    scale = lane["scale"]
    y = lane["y"]
    legdur = 0.53 + idx * 0.012
    phase = legdur

    # phase offsets for a transverse gallop: far hind, near hind, far front, near front
    b_nf = 0.0
    b_ff = -0.10 * phase
    b_nh = -0.50 * phase
    b_fh = -0.60 * phase

    far_legs = (
        leg(-56, -82, 40, 34, 17, 9, "48;12;-32;0;48", "-10;18;46;8;-10",
            cfg["dark"], cfg["dark"], cfg["coat"], cfg["hoof"], b_fh, legdur, True)
        + leg(34, -78, 34, 34, 13, 8, "22;-15;-58;-12;22", "8;28;62;18;8",
              cfg["dark"], cfg["dark"], cfg["coat"], cfg["hoof"], b_ff, legdur)
    )
    near_legs = (
        leg(-48, -82, 40, 34, 17, 9, "48;12;-32;0;48", "-10;18;46;8;-10",
            cfg["coat"], cfg["dark"], cfg["light"], cfg["hoof"], b_nh, legdur, True)
        + leg(42, -78, 34, 34, 13, 8, "22;-15;-58;-12;22", "8;28;62;18;8",
              cfg["coat"], cfg["dark"], cfg["light"], cfg["hoof"], b_nf, legdur)
    )

    # Dust puffs trailing the hooves
    dust = ""
    for j, (dx, dy, rx, ry, delay) in enumerate([
        (-36, -8, 11, 6, -0.05), (-58, -13, 15, 8, -0.35),
        (-82, -20, 19, 10, -0.65), (-24, -3, 8, 4, -0.80),
    ]):
        dust += (f'<ellipse class="dust" cx="{dx}" cy="{dy}" rx="{rx}" ry="{ry}" '
                 f'fill="#d8bd86" style="animation-delay:{delay}s"/>')

    # Sash on the jockey's silks
    sash = (f'<path d="M -10,-119 L 16,-150 L 23,-143 L -3,-112 Z" '
            f'fill="{cfg["accent"]}" clip-path="url(#torso{idx})" opacity=".95"/>')

    return f'''
  <!-- ================= HORSE {n} : {cfg["name"]} ================= -->
  <g transform="translate(0,{y})">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
        values="-330,0;1270,0" dur="{dur}s" begin="{begin}s"
        repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="linear"/>
      <g transform="scale({scale})">
        <ellipse cx="-8" cy="3" rx="102" ry="9" fill="#14351a" opacity=".32"/>
        {dust}
        <g class="bob" style="animation-duration:{legdur:.2f}s;animation-delay:{begin * 0.11:.2f}s">
          <!-- tail -->
          <g>
            <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
              values="-5 -70 -92;6 -70 -92;-5 -70 -92" dur="1.05s"
              begin="{begin * 0.3:.2f}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <path d="{TAIL_PATH}" fill="url(#mane{idx})"/>
            <path d="M -72,-90 C -92,-88 -112,-76 -126,-58 C -116,-68 -102,-76 -88,-82"
              stroke="{cfg["maneLight"]}" stroke-width="4" fill="none"
              stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".55"/>
          </g>
          {far_legs}
          <!-- neck -->
          <path d="{NECK_PATH}" fill="{cfg["coat"]}"/>
          <path d="M 48,-100 C 62,-112 76,-128 88,-144" stroke="{cfg["light"]}"
            stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".45"/>
          <!-- body -->
          <path d="{BODY_PATH}" fill="url(#coat{idx})"/>
          <path d="M -72,-58 C -54,-48 -24,-42 4,-43 C 32,-44 56,-50 66,-60
                   C 58,-48 38,-38 8,-37 C -22,-37 -54,-44 -72,-58 Z"
            fill="{cfg["dark"]}" opacity=".38"/>
          <path d="M -62,-100 C -48,-112 -18,-114 6,-110 C 26,-107 44,-100 56,-90
                   C 42,-100 20,-104 -2,-105 C -28,-106 -50,-104 -62,-100 Z"
            fill="{cfg["light"]}" opacity=".55"/>
          <path d="M -52,-104 C -58,-88 -58,-70 -52,-56" stroke="{cfg["light"]}"
            stroke-width="3" fill="none" opacity=".3"/>
          {near_legs}
          <!-- head -->
          <path d="{HEAD_PATH}" fill="url(#coat{idx})"/>
          <path d="M 90,-158 L 88,-176 L 99,-164 Z" fill="{cfg["coat"]}"/>
          <path d="M 101,-164 L 103,-182 L 112,-168 Z" fill="{cfg["coat"]}"/>
          <path d="M 101,-164 L 103,-182 L 112,-168 Z" fill="{cfg["dark"]}" opacity=".25"/>
          <ellipse cx="143" cy="-144" rx="9" ry="5.5" fill="{cfg["dark"]}" opacity=".32"/>
          <path d="M 104,-136 C 111,-130 120,-128 129,-133" stroke="{cfg["dark"]}"
            stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" opacity=".55"/>
          <circle cx="110" cy="-151" r="2.8" fill="#15100d"/>
          <circle cx="111" cy="-152" r=".9" fill="#fff" opacity=".8"/>
          <ellipse cx="145" cy="-143" rx="2.3" ry="1.5" fill="#1d120c" opacity=".75"/>
          <!-- bridle -->
          <path d="M 96,-151 L 119,-147 M 114,-161 L 119,-135" stroke="#2a1c14"
            stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity=".85"/>
          <circle cx="121" cy="-135" r="2.4" fill="#c9a84a" stroke="#4a3517" stroke-width=".8"/>
          <!-- mane -->
          <g>
            <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
              values="-4 90 -150;5 90 -150;-4 90 -150" dur="0.82s"
              begin="{begin * 0.23:.2f}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <path d="{MANE_PATH}" fill="url(#mane{idx})"/>
            <path d="M 90,-150 C 82,-138 76,-124 70,-112" stroke="{cfg["maneLight"]}"
              stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".6"/>
            <path d="M 93,-153 C 85,-158 82,-164 83,-170 C 88,-164 92,-160 96,-156 Z"
              fill="{cfg["mane"]}"/>
          </g>
          <!-- saddle cloth and saddle -->
          <path d="M -25,-113 L 25,-115 L 29,-82 L -21,-80 Z" fill="#f4efe2"
            stroke="{cfg["silk"]}" stroke-width="2.5"/>
          <path d="M -21,-111 L 21,-112 L 23,-85 L -17,-83 Z" fill="none"
            stroke="{cfg["accent"]}" stroke-width="1.2" opacity=".8"/>
          <text x="-6" y="-87" font-family="Arial Black, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="21"
            font-weight="900" fill="#16202a" text-anchor="middle">{n}</text>
          <path d="M -23,-116 C -12,-123 12,-123 24,-115 L 19,-104 C 7,-110 -10,-110 -19,-106 Z"
            fill="#4a2c1c" stroke="#2b180e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          <path d="M -14,-116 C -4,-120 8,-120 17,-116" stroke="#8a5a38" stroke-width="2"
            fill="none"/>
          <path d="M 10,-108 L 8,-80" stroke="#2b2b2b" stroke-width="2"/>
          <path d="M 4,-80 L 12,-80 L 12,-75 L 4,-75 Z" fill="none" stroke="#c9ccd1"
            stroke-width="2"/>
          <!-- jockey far leg -->
          <path d="M -5,-112 L 6,-98 L -2,-80" stroke="#d8d3c4" stroke-width="8"
            fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M -2,-80 L -5,-73" stroke="#161616" stroke-width="9"
            stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <!-- jockey torso -->
          <clipPath id="torso{idx}"><path d="{TORSO_PATH}"/></clipPath>
          <path d="{TORSO_PATH}" fill="{cfg["silk"]}"/>
          {sash}
          <path d="M -4,-104 C 2,-111 9,-116 17,-118" stroke="{cfg["silkDark"]}"
            stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity=".7"/>
          <!-- far arm with whip -->
          <g>
            <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
              values="-7 -13 -169;9 -13 -169;-7 -13 -169" dur="0.78s"
              begin="{begin * 0.17:.2f}s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            <path d="M 8,-148 C 2,-156 -5,-163 -13,-169" stroke="{cfg["silkDark"]}"
              stroke-width="6.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <path d="M -13,-169 C -24,-176 -35,-182 -47,-186" stroke="#f3e4c4"
              stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
            <circle cx="-13" cy="-169" r="3.4" fill="#2a2018"/>
          </g>
          <!-- near leg -->
          <path d="M -2,-111 L 11,-96 L 4,-78" stroke="#f4f1e6" stroke-width="9"
            fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M 11,-96 L 4,-78" stroke="#e7e1d2" stroke-width="7"
            fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <path d="M 4,-78 L 1,-71" stroke="#1b1b1b" stroke-width="9"
            stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <path d="M -3,-72 L 6,-72 L 7,-68 L -5,-68 Z" fill="#111"/>
          <!-- near arm -->
          <path d="M 12,-148 C 20,-142 28,-138 36,-134" stroke="{cfg["accent"]}"
            stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <circle cx="37" cy="-133" r="3.8" fill="#2a2018"/>
          <!-- reins -->
          <path d="M 37,-133 C 70,-127 98,-131 121,-135" stroke="#2c1f17"
            stroke-width="1.8" fill="none"/>
          <!-- head -->
          <circle cx="22" cy="-161" r="8.6" fill="{cfg["skin"]}"/>
          <path d="M 14,-166 C 14,-176 24,-181 31,-175 C 35,-172 36,-167 35,-163
                   L 20,-160 Z" fill="{cfg["cap"]}"/>
          <path d="M 33,-167 L 45,-164 L 33,-160 Z" fill="{cfg["capAccent"]}"/>
          <path d="M 16,-172 C 21,-178 29,-178 33,-174" stroke="{cfg["capAccent"]}"
            stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity=".9"/>
          <ellipse cx="27" cy="-162" rx="5.2" ry="3.6" fill="#1e293b"/>
          <ellipse cx="28.5" cy="-163" rx="1.5" ry="1" fill="#eaf4ff" opacity=".9"/>
          <path d="M 18,-163 L 33,-161" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.8"/>
          <circle cx="21" cy="-155" r="1.8" fill="{cfg["skin"]}" opacity=".8"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>'''


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Crowd
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
crowd_colors = ["#e94f4f", "#f6c85f", "#5ec3e8", "#7ed17e", "#f28cb8",
                "#c49cf0", "#ff9b54", "#f4f1e8", "#65d6c4", "#8aa7ff",
                "#ffd166", "#e26d5c"]
crowd = ""
rows = [(231, 7.8, 4.2), (259, 9.0, 4.5), (287, 10.2, 4.8), (315, 11.4, 5.1)]
for ri, (ry, step, r) in enumerate(rows):
    x = 58 + (ri % 2) * 3
    while x < 642:
        col = random.choice(crowd_colors)
        hat = random.random() < 0.28
        delay = -random.uniform(0, 1.8)
        hx = x + random.uniform(-1.5, 1.5)
        hy = ry - random.uniform(0, 2)
        crowd += (f'<g class="crowd" style="animation-delay:{delay:.2f}s">'
                  f'<rect x="{hx - 4.2:.1f}" y="{hy - 1:.1f}" width="8.4" height="8.5" rx="2.6" fill="{col}"/>'
                  f'<circle cx="{hx:.1f}" cy="{hy - 4.4:.1f}" r="{r:.1f}" fill="{random.choice(["#f2c9a0", "#d9a06b", "#a86f45", "#f7d7b8", "#8c5a36"])}"/>')
        if hat:
            crowd += (f'<ellipse cx="{hx:.1f}" cy="{hy - 6.6:.1f}" rx="{r + 1.2:.1f}" ry="1.8" fill="{random.choice(crowd_colors)}"/>')
        crowd += "</g>"
        x += step + random.uniform(-1.2, 1.2)

# A few spectators with raised arms / little flags
crowd_flags = ""
for i, x in enumerate([92, 154, 228, 304, 372, 448, 522, 598]):
    ry = [231, 259, 287, 315][i % 4]
    flag_col = ["#ffd23f", "#e94f4f", "#5ec3e8", "#7ed17e"][i % 4]
    crowd_flags += f'''
      <g transform="translate({x},{ry - 13})">
        <path d="M0,0 L0,-22" stroke="#4b3a2a" stroke-width="1.6"/>
        <g class="flag-mini" style="animation-delay:-{i * 0.17:.2f}s">
          <path d="M0,-22 C7,-26 14,-26 21,-21 L21,-13 C14,-18 7,-18 0,-14 Z" fill="{flag_col}"/>
        </g>
        <circle cx="-4" cy="1" r="2.4" fill="#e8b98e"/>
        <path d="M-4,3 L-4,-3" stroke="#f4f1e8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>'''

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Grandstand roof pennants
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pennants = ""
for i, x in enumerate(range(58, 646, 27)):
    col = ["#ffd23f", "#e94f4f", "#5ec3e8", "#f4f1e8", "#7ed17e"][i % 5]
    pennants += f'''
      <g transform="translate({x},176)">
        <path d="M0,0 L0,10" stroke="#cbd5d8" stroke-width="1"/>
        <g class="flag-mini" style="animation-delay:-{i * 0.09:.2f}s">
          <path d="M0,1 L13,5 L0,10 Z" fill="{col}"/>
        </g>
      </g>'''

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Track texture / grass tufts
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
stripes = ""
for x in range(-100, 1300, 118):
    stripes += (f'<path d="M {x},356 L {x + 64},356 L {x + 34},692 L {x - 30},692 Z" '
                f'fill="#ffffff" opacity=".045"/>')

tufts = ""
for i in range(110):
    x = random.uniform(6, 1194)
    y = random.uniform(702, 792)
    s = random.uniform(0.55, 1.25)
    col = random.choice(["#3e7a38", "#4d8a43", "#2e622c", "#5d9a4f"])
    tufts += (f'<path d="M {x:.1f},{y:.1f} l {-3*s:.1f},{-8*s:.1f} M {x:.1f},{y:.1f} '
              f'l {0.5*s:.1f},{-11*s:.1f} M {x:.1f},{y:.1f} l {4*s:.1f},{-7*s:.1f}" '
              f'stroke="{col}" stroke-width="{1.5*s:.1f}" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>')

flowers = ""
for i in range(34):
    x = random.uniform(12, 1188)
    y = random.uniform(710, 786)
    col = random.choice(["#f7f0d0", "#ffd166", "#f28cb8", "#e8f4ff"])
    flowers += (f'<circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="2.3" fill="{col}" opacity=".9"/>'
                f'<circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="0.9" fill="#e0a52e"/>')

infield_tufts = ""
for i in range(42):
    x = random.uniform(10, 1190)
    y = random.uniform(332, 357)
    infield_tufts += (f'<path d="M {x:.1f},{y:.1f} l -2,-6 M {x:.1f},{y:.1f} l 0,-8 '
                      f'M {x:.1f},{y:.1f} l 2,-6" stroke="#4d8a43" stroke-width="1.4" '
                      f'fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clouds / birds
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
clouds = ""
cloud_data = [
    (105, 68, 1.00, 96, -22, .88),
    (390, 42, 0.72, 120, -70, .72),
    (690, 105, 0.88, 84, -46, .80),
    (960, 55, 0.60, 135, -105, .62),
]
for cx, cy, s, dur, delay, op in cloud_data:
    clouds += f'''
      <g class="cloud" style="animation-duration:{dur}s;animation-delay:{delay}s;opacity:{op}">
        <g transform="translate({cx},{cy}) scale({s})">
          <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="54" ry="20" fill="#ffffff"/>
          <ellipse cx="38" cy="-8" rx="38" ry="23" fill="#ffffff"/>
          <ellipse cx="-38" cy="4" rx="33" ry="16" fill="#ffffff"/>
          <ellipse cx="12" cy="-16" rx="27" ry="18" fill="#ffffff"/>
          <ellipse cx="0" cy="11" rx="62" ry="11" fill="#dcecf5" opacity=".55"/>
        </g>
      </g>'''

birds = ""
for i, (bx, by, dur, delay) in enumerate([(240, 120, 38, -5), (300, 145, 44, -22), (520, 95, 52, -34)]):
    birds += f'''
      <g class="bird-drift" style="animation-duration:{dur}s;animation-delay:{delay}s">
        <g transform="translate({bx},{by}) scale({0.8 + i*0.15})">
          <g class="bird-flap" style="animation-delay:-{i*0.12:.2f}s">
            <path d="M -9,0 Q -4,-6 0,0 Q 4,-6 9,0" stroke="#3a4a52" stroke-width="1.8"
              fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>'''

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tote board rows
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
board_rows = ""
for i, hcfg in enumerate(HORSES):
    ry = 166 + i * 17
    board_rows += f'''
      <g>
